name: Sun Mote
title: Ribbon-Tailed Solar Wisp
biography: A faceted ivory core floats inside eight golden rays. Two red ribbons trail behind this small remnant of the broken celestial mechanism.
weakness: Its pulsing rays leave a small safe center and a recovery opening.
origin: The Sunken Orrery, an original fictional PawTrail location

skills.name: Mote Pulse
skills.description: A golden pulse forms around the core. Stand in the clear center or outside its rim.
